title: Can I En Passant Checkmate?
summary: Normal chess vs Martin where the goal is to deliver checkmate with an en passant capture. Tony trades off Martin's pieces while keeping Martin's 7th-rank pawns unmoved, promotes extra pieces to build a mating net and avoid stalemate, then waits for Martin to play ...e7-e5 and captures dxe6 e.p. for checkmate (~9:44).
rules: Challenge: the checkmating move must be an en passant capture (ordinary mates don't count).

board.theme_notes: standard chess.com green; meme overlays in edit

current_impl_issues: Impl specialmate k=ep makes other mates a draw — reasonable; verify the bot actually tends to push a 2-square pawn so the goal is reachable.
evidence: 0:01 'trying to en passant checkmate Martin'; 9:44 'with pawn E5 we can take on E6 and we do get en passant checkmate'. Frame visual_b: normal chess, Martin (250).
